title: What It Actually Looks Like to Grieve and Still Hope in God
caption:
Some of you are walking into your first Christmas without someone.

The world will tell you to stay strong, keep busy, be there for everybody else. Scripture gives you more room than that.

Jesus wept at a tomb He was about to empty. The Psalms are full of men asking God how long. Grief isn't a lack of faith. It's love with nowhere to go.

So tell God the truth about it. Text one brother the date that's coming. And grieve like a man with a future, because you have one.

"We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about those who are asleep, that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope." 1 Thessalonians 4:13

Save this for the hard day. Send it to the brother who's carrying more than he says.
